title: Indian scientists produce most detailed 3D atlas of the human brainstem
summary: Indian scientists have developed the most detailed 3D atlas of the human brainstem, providing unprecedented anatomical mapping that could revolutionize neurosurgery and advance understanding of neurological disorders affecting this critical brain region.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of detailed anatomical reference maps of the human brainstem, a complex region critical for vital functions like breathing and heart rate.
why_valuable: This high-resolution atlas can serve as a crucial surgical planning tool and research reference, potentially improving outcomes for brainstem-related surgeries and advancing neuroscience research globally.
